page_title: MAI 1-3 STU | Mainz v Stuttgart 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Harm Osmers has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' 1 - 3 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) surprises all the fans with a long-range header that beats the goalkeeper. The ball ends up under the crossbar and the score changes to 1:3.
90+6' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+5' Merveille Papela (Mainz) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alexander Nubel sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The referee signals a corner kick to Mainz.
90+5' Substitution. Hiroki Ito will be replaced by Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
90+3' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Serhou Guirassy, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the right post.
90' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
89' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

87' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
87' Merveille Papela (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Stuttgart in a dangerous position.
85' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Enzo Millot is replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
85' Chris Fuhrich comes off the pitch to be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).

84' 1 - 2 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Robin Zentner is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.
82' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
78' Bo Svensson is forced to make a change. Karim Onisiwo is unable to continue due to injury, Merveille Papela (Mainz) comes on.
77' The game is interrupted now, Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' 43:57 – the ratio of ball possession.
75' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) brings an opponent down and Harm Osmers interrupts the game.
72' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart).
72' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
69' 1 - 1 What a brilliant finish! Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and fires the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.
69' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Tom Krauss (Mainz) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
68' Substitution. Silas is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
67' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Stefan Bell and he is replaced by Tom Krauss (Mainz).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aymen Barkok (Mainz) comes onto the pitch so that Jae-Sung Lee can be given a rest.
67' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
62' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
60' What was Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' Substitution. Marco Richter leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
56' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a mazy run and from inside the box he beats Robin Zentner with a delightful chip. He makes it 0:1.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
54' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
54' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
48' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
43' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
41' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall.
40' Stefan Bell (Mainz) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Stuttgart win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
39' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
34' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Stuttgart get a corner.
32' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) brought his opponent down.
31' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
29' Anthony Caci (Mainz) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
28' Harm Osmers has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart).
26' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
23' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
23' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Mainz will take a corner.
20' Marco Richter (Mainz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' Robin Zentner comes off his line to intercept the corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
19' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
8' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers is the one to supervise the game today.
